source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("old city" OR "historic city" OR "walled city" OR "historic core" OR "Old Delhi" OR Shahjahanabad) AND (heritage OR nostalgia OR tourism OR conservation OR redevelopment OR consumption)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("old city" OR "historic city" OR "walled city" OR "historic core" OR "Old Delhi" OR Shahjahanabad) AND (heritage OR nostalgia OR tourism OR conservation OR redevelopment OR consumption),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("Shahjahanabad" OR "Old Delhi" OR "historic city" OR "historic core" OR "old city" OR "walled city") AND ("conservation" OR "consumption" OR "heritage" OR "nostalgia" OR "redevelopment" OR "tourism"))
